popCulture.title: Iphigenia in Aulis
popCulture.creator: Euripides
popCulture.description: Euripides' Clytemnestra recalls that Agamemnon slew her first husband and tore their child from her breast — Tantalus the Younger as the prior marriage behind the Aulis quarrel.

popCulture.title: Bibliotheca
popCulture.creator: Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Apollodorus keeps Tantalus as Clytemnestra's first husband, killed with their infant by Agamemnon before the forced Mycenaean marriage.

popCulture.title: Tantalus (son of Thyestes)
popCulture.description: Adult prince whom Agamemnon killed to take Clytemnestra — distinct in this atlas from the banquet-infant of the same name (Wikipedia conflates both).
